name: @chartkitdev/react
description: Charts an agent can write and a server can render. One JSON spec. @chartkitdev/core renders SVG with zero dependencies, in Node or the browser. validate() and repair() run locally with no model call. Adapters for React, Vue, Svelte, Astro, Solid, Qwik, Angular, and vanilla. Benchmarks, including losses: https://chartkit.dev/benchmarks.json

core.repair: import { repair } from "@chartkitdev/core/validate"; const { spec, ok, errors, applied } = repair(input). Applies every JSON Patch fix from validate(). repairAsync(input) from "@chartkitdev/core/validate/convert" also converts Chart.js, ECharts, Vega-Lite, Plotly, and Recharts configs and fixes misplaced keys. Render spec when ok.
core.optIn: import { createRenderer } from "@chartkitdev/core"; import { line } from "@chartkitdev/core/charts/line"; const render = createRenderer([line]);

react.example: <Chart spec={{ version: "1", type: "line", data: rows, encoding: { x: { field: "month" }, y: { field: "revenue" } } }} />

props.spec: Required. A v1 chart spec, the same JSON object every adapter takes.
props.style: Inline style on the host element.
props.render: Optional (spec) => string. Defaults to the core charts. Pass createRenderer([...]) from @chartkitdev/core to ship a subset.
props.onPointClick: Called with the click detail for a mark, or Enter/Space on the focused point.
props.onSeriesClick: Called with the click detail for a series.
props.onLegendClick: Called with the click detail for a legend item.
props.selection: Controlled selection. Omit it to let the chart own the state.
props.tooltip: Replaces the tooltip card. Return HTML, a node, or null to hide it.

react.ssr: import { renderToString } from "@chartkitdev/react/ssr"; renderToString(spec) returns the HTML string.

legacy.status: Frozen. The v0 prop components (LineChart, BarChart, KpiCard and the rest), their hooks, themes and scale helpers get fixes, not features. New code uses <Chart spec={...} />.

themes.use: Set theme.preset in the spec, for example "theme": { "preset": "soft" }.
